where_the_gate_lives: infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/reports/commentary_composition.py:read_composition (line 131; the check is line 146, handle line 169, ports composed in compose_ports line 189 and handed on in lambda_handler line 226)
why_there: Every path into the drafter reads a composition through its ONE composition_reader port, which invokes irpt-commentary-composition-read-lambda, so a refusal at that function binds the queue path, the stream path and the mixed-event path with a single check and the drafter's own code (which already records a refused read as failed at stage composition, with no model call, no draft stored and nothing sent) needs no change; the drafter holds no job reader and no DynamoDB grant, so putting the gate there would need a new port AND a new grant on a function that has neither. The composition read cannot read the jobs table today (new_permission_needed YES, see permission_evidence), so the gate is built and tested with fakes and is inert-safe: until the release adds the grant, the job read in the deployed function would fail with AccessDenied (a FunctionError the drafter records as failed at stage composition), never a draft for a non-READY job.

permission_evidence: infra/aws/terraform/investor-reporting/export/commentary_composition.tf:55-85 (aws_iam_role_policy.commentary_composition_read): S1ReadAcceptanceAndRetentionRowsInServedFirmPartitions (lines 62-65) allows dynamodb:GetItem on tables.requests ONLY, with dynamodb:LeadingKeys = local.b1_served_firms; S2DecryptIndexReadsViaDynamoOnly (lines 66-71) allows kms:Decrypt on the irpt key only where kms:EncryptionContext:aws:dynamodb:tableName == tables.requests. The jobs table (infra/aws/terraform/investor-reporting/core/dynamodb.tf:60-79, name irpt-jobs, hash tenant, range job) is encrypted with the same irpt KMS key. The release needs: (1) S1 Resource extended with the jobs table arn arn:aws:dynamodb:${local.region}:${local.account_id}:table/${data.terraform_remote_state.core.outputs.tables.jobs} (same LeadingKeys condition; dynamodb:GetItem only, no write); (2) S2 condition kms:EncryptionContext:aws:dynamodb:tableName widened to [tables.requests, tables.jobs]. The function already has env IRPT_JOBS_TABLE (commentary_composition.tf:105). No Terraform was written in this cell.

paths_into_the_drafter: queue path: SQS record (eventSource aws:sqs) -> admit_ready_message -> entry.ready_item_from_message -> entry.ready_handler(items, reader=ports['composition_reader']) (lambda_handler.py:295) -> _run_ready_item -> read_composition(reader) -- covered: the reader is the gated invoke; a refusal lands failed {stage composition, reason UNAVAILABLE} before abstract_request, so model, persist_draft and send are never reached (test_the_drafter_stores_no_draft_and_sends_nothing_when_the_gate_refuses drives this path)

non-queue path: any event with no SQS record (a DynamoDB-stream INSERT of a REPORT# ANALYSIS item, or a hand-built invoke) -> entry.handler(event, reader=ports['composition_reader']) (lambda_handler.py:279) -> _ready_item -> _run_ready_item -> the same reader -- covered identically; the only difference is the stream path posts a ticket instead of storing, which is also behind the failed result

mixed event: SQS records plus non-SQS records in one event -> the SQS part via ready_handler and the rest via entry.handler(..., reader=ports['composition_reader']) (lambda_handler.py:301) -- covered, both reach the one reader

no path reaches persist_draft, send or drafter.draft without an extracted result, and an extracted result exists only after composition_reader returned; entry.py has no second reader and no cache of one
what_a_hand_built_invoke_gets_now: A hand-built analysis_ready message or stream-shaped event for a request whose job does not read READY gets no draft and no commentary_ready message: the composition read refuses UNAVAILABLE and the drafter records the request as failed at stage composition (the deployed function does so once the release carries this module plus the jobs-table grant); before this order it got a stored draft and a commentary_ready message in any job state.
